claim.summary: Guarded operation invocation captures bounded settlement branches behind private acknowledgement authority, while guarded resource refresh delegates exact current lifecycle snapshots.

semantics.actionCardinality: exactly one operation.invoke or resource.refresh action
semantics.guardOrdering: guard before discriminator and every payload observation
semantics.falseGuard: zero payload reads, payload-token calls, delegated effects, and diagnostic reports
semantics.operationTokenSession: true guard and named operation input share one detached action-local M04-T10 cache
semantics.resourceTokenSession: resource declaration input remains independently owned and materialized by M04-T08
semantics.operationInput: canonical named synthetic array materialization before exact M04-T09 schema validation
semantics.handlerCapture: both branches detached, bounded, and frozen before accepted invocation
semantics.settlementMapping: succeeded selects onSuccess; public/technical failure selects onFailure; superseded/disposed selects none
semantics.acknowledgement: raw lease hidden behind package-internal opaque one-shot authority; no auto-acknowledgement
semantics.resourceRefresh: exact current M04-T08 snapshot plus factory resolution snapshot, returned nonblocking
semantics.exclusiveOwnership: one live T11 compositor claim; trusted caller profile surrenders direct primitive use
semantics.disposal: terminally disposes exclusively claimed T08/T09 managers and invalidates private tickets
